## History

Charlie Sloane is an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolboy known among his peers for his family's colorful stories, including his claim that his grandmother saw his deceased grandfather driving cows a year after his burial. He developed an admiration for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), reporting to his mother that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in the school. During his time at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, he joined the advanced Queen's preparation class organized by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) to prepare for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their classmates.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
